Annotators split each paragraph into sentences, then label (i) the hallucination orientation (intrinsic, extrinsic, or none), (ii) the hallucination category (six defined types or miscellaneous), and (iii) the degree of hallucination (mild, moderate, alarming).

We follow a three-level annotation process where we first determine whether there is a hallucination or not, and if yes, then what orientation.
